body: 14 Nov 2026: verified on an emulator against VM 108 updated to sha-7c7fa60 (engineering check, not the release-candidate pair; build 150, dbe63d0): searching 'hate me blue october' puts the library song 'Hate Me' (Blue October) as the Top result and it carries the three-dot menu above its play button, like the library row below it. Songs that exist only in the catalogue (the rows with 'Request') still have no menu, as noted. Not walked.
